create_object_detection_evaluator: create an ObjectDetectionEvaluator with categories and IOU threshold to evaluate object detection metrics
add_groundtruth_image_info: add ground truth boxes and classes for a single image to the evaluation database
add_detected_image_info: add detection boxes, scores, and classes for a single image to the evaluation database
evaluate_detection_metrics: evaluate precision, recall, mean average precision, and CorLoc from added ground truth and detections
create_pascal_detection_evaluator: create a PascalDetectionEvaluator with categories and IOU threshold for PASCAL VOC style evaluation
